description: EXPERIMENTAL FD-03: 6S speed variant of the Dartwing 780 (FD-01), an original fast swept flying-wing EPO pusher in the 0.78 m speed-wing class. Same d1 airframe and textbook tailless aerodynamics; 1.42 kg 6S speed build (2000 Kv-class motor, measured UIUC APC Sport 7x9 map, 6S 4000 mAh pack), estimated electric drive on the finite 6S 4000 mAh (Gens ace G-tech class) pack (pack_ecm), built to hold 360 km/h level. No landing gear (hand launch), tougher foam airframe. Not flight validated.

level_speed.source: FD-03: slow level reference for the 6S speed build, 2.25 times its 13.2 m/s clean stall. The airborne start trims at 50 % throttle and searches up to 2.5 times this speed; this build flies about 62-70 m/s at half throttle, beyond 2.5 times the base Dartwing's 1.5-times-stall reference

hand_launch_speed.source: FD-03: a hard running overhand throw (about 40 km/h), as heavy 6S speed wings are launched; the shared 6.5 m/s standing throw is below this build's 13 m/s stall and too slow to outrun the propeller torque. Estimate; FD-03 README launch study

conventions.rudder: none: fixed fins, every rudder term is 0
